body:
Three self-contained ports from lean-workspace-template:

- **popover.inline.ts** (`4fb49d25`, `660add27`): cache popovers by the hashless/searchless fetch URL instead of `link.pathname` — fixes stale/wrong previews when two links share a pathname but differ by hash or query (common on citation-heavy pages) — plus in-flight fetch race guards, null-safe `Content-Type`, and deduped mouseenter bindings. Canvas-specific styling from the source commits deliberately not ported.
- **config-loader** (`5ca879f7`, `b28ad09f`): a plugin's `layout` may now be an array, so one component can render in multiple responsive placements (search: standalone mobile row + grouped desktop slot). Includes the regression test wired into `test-scripts.yml`, static imports replacing inline `require()`s, the `layoutDeclaration` schema `$defs`, and the matching mobile-search selector in `custom.scss`.
- **.gitignore** (`94525b72`): ignore `.env`/`.env.*` (keep `!.env.example`) — local secrets were previously committable. Plus `checkout@v5`/`setup-node@v5`.

- **Landing page + mobile nav bar** (second commit; lean `bfbac6b5`, `260ea2b1`, and the config half of `5ca879f7`): the landing card now shares every other page's width and top alignment — capped content column with a flexible right spacer replaces the index-only 85%-centered layout — and search/darkmode declare array-form placements, activating the loader mechanism above so the mobile nav renders search on its own row and the theme toggle standalone.

Verified locally: `npm run check`, the new loader test, and a full site build all pass.

**Stack 5/5.**
